s: Budgets: page < 3 s cold, slicer interaction < 1 s, refresh < 30 min, model < 1 GB (pick numbers from the business need and today's baseline).
Method: same test machine, Performance Analyzer after clearing the cache (or DAX Studio with cleared cache), same data snapshot.
Gate: page and interaction budgets block release; refresh and size warn and create a ticket. Record results per release so the trend is visible.
qa-ops-1.check: Any budget is fine if it's measurable, measured consistently and enforced at release.
